source_products.title: life styles square pillow cover & insert
source_products.category: Décor & Pillows / Decorative Pillows & Blankets / Throw Pillows
source_products.description: this pillow is an exquisite combination of elegance , flair , delightful , and unique style . toss a few around your favorite room for entertaining , or use them to add comfort and style to your own private space . wherever you place them , you ’ re sure to enjoy the casual charm and eye-catching embellishments of these fun and fashionable pillow designs . this pillow has something special for every decorating taste . this delightfully textured pillow is crafted in a soft fabric , with a gathered and pin-tucked cover for an irresistibly touchable effect . soft and comfy , great for lounging on your bed or sofa .

source_products.title: square cotton pillow cover and insert
source_products.category: Décor & Pillows / Decorative Pillows & Blankets / Throw Pillows
source_products.description: a fabulous range of exotic pillows and poufs to suit a variety of lifestyles . including clever cheery designs on natural jute fabric , fun , and funky international expressions , bold floral and abstract patterns , and sophisticated textured motifs . handcrafted of smooth cotton yarns , these modern throw pillow lends chic appeal to the farmhouse and country styles . braided and twisted stripes in blue/mustard/gray/blush and white adorn its white cover , ending in a series of tasseled fringe for a refreshing pop of color on your sofa or bed . this square throw pillow includes a removable polyester insert with zipper closure .

source_products.title: pillow insert

source_products.title: wayfair basics® rectangular pillow insert
source_products.category: Décor & Pillows / Decorative Pillows & Blankets / Throw Pillows / White Throw Pillows
source_products.description: you found your favorite throw pillow , now fill it out with this essential pillow insert ! made from super-soft polyester microfiber , the shell sports a clean white finish . designed to fit most standard pillow sizes , this insert is stuffed with a polyfill to a 4 '' thickness so your pillow will stay plump and keep its shape . designed for universal use , these pillows are hypoallergenic for sensitive sleepers , and machine washable and dryer-safe for effortless upkeep .
attributes: productcare : machine wash and tumble dry
